_README: LST-ORPH-05 catalog inventory. EVERY catalogs.* base table must carry a classification: ROUTED (reachable via a registered route + hub tile), HEADLESS-BY-DESIGN (a system lookup no operator edits), or RETIRE (superseded; must never gain an editable route). ROUTED-READ-ONLY means the catalog IS reachable at its own route but is deliberately not editable (code-managed or owner-gated) — it must never gain a creator wizard. ROUTED-PENDING means the owner has ruled it an operator surface (QuickBooks-style creator wizard) but the route/creator is not built yet. UNCLASSIFIED is a DEFECT the guard fails on — a catalog nobody has ruled on is how a table quietly becomes unreachable or wrongly editable. Row counts are a 2026-07-28 prod snapshot (pg_class/pg_stat_all_tables, role-safe) and are informational only; the guard checks CLASSIFICATION, never counts.
